name: auction-react
description: Online auction house template — lots, bidding with minimum increment, live countdown, reserve price, auto-bidding and awards with commission. Free, MIT, no backend.

paragraphs: An auction house with both of its sides, built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite 6 and Tailwind CSS v4: the floor where bidders compete and the desk where the auctioneer runs the sale. Bidders get sales with a countdown, a lot page with gallery, condition report and a bid box that enforces the minimum increment, automatic bidding with a ceiling, a live bid history, and a "my bids" view that separates winning, outbid and won. The auctioneer gets CRUD for sales and lots, a reserve price that never leaks, bid cancellation, awards with the commission worked out, and vetted bidders. The current…
